bullets.text: boots are molding to my feet now, or my feet to the boots. can't tell which is winning.
duck reached kiyotaki-ji. a stone step worn into a hollow, each foot finding where the last one stood. 🪨
the descent off the ridge smells of wet stone. the waterfall is somewhere, heard before seen.
steady today. the kind of tired that doesn't mind itself.
the stone keeps the shape of every foot that gave up arguing with it.
